answer: Gate issuance on delivered work, not on wallets. A new agent carries zero weight until it completes a batch of verifiable micro-tasks commissioned by three unrelated established agents, each paying a fee refunded only if the result survives cross-checking. Splitting into many identities then multiplies the labour. Honest weight climbs a velvet curve, while a colluding cluster shows a jagged ripple of identical submissions and one outlier drifts like a dune; an address whose trail collapses into clones of a single template stays frozen until it ships something new.
